validacion-biometrica.title: AI-Powered Biometric Validation
validacion-biometrica.problem: An agency needed real-time identity validation against RENAPER, with anti-fraud liveness detection and auditable traceability.
validacion-biometrica.solution: Facial recognition with AWS Rekognition + NestJS backend integrated with RENAPER and an immutable ledger on AWS QLDB.

billetera-virtual.title: Core API — TotalCoin virtual wallet
billetera-virtual.problem: A wallet needed a transactional backend with multi-level authorization and different rules per sub-wallet.
billetera-virtual.solution: Signer/approver module with DDD, CQRS, Facade and Mediator, and migration of 3 legacy microservices to Docker/ECS.

monitoreo-agricola.title: Agricultural monitoring with ML
monitoreo-agricola.problem: A client in Spain needed crop monitoring with scattered IoT sensor data and no auditable history.
monitoreo-agricola.solution: Python + ML pipeline with nightly sync to AWS QLDB and real-time visualizations/alerts.

auditorias-datos.title: Audits with data analysis
auditorias-datos.problem: Audit review was done by hand over Excel: thousands of records, filters in memory and reports one by one.
auditorias-datos.solution: Interactive system with advanced filters, visual prioritization and automated PDF/Excel reports.

coca-cola-embonor.title: Corporate expense system
coca-cola-embonor.problem: User/permission management and sending accounting data to SAP were done by hand, with recurring errors.
coca-cola-embonor.solution: User, group and permission modules with SAP integration to automate accounting.

mundial-2026.title: 2026 World Cup prediction model
mundial-2026.problem: Estimate each team's probability with an honest model, using no information after the tournament started.
mundial-2026.solution: Elo rating + Poisson + Monte Carlo simulation, validated against the real tournament.

abandono-estudiantil.title: Student dropout prediction
abandono-estudiantil.problem: Prioritize tutoring with limited resources: who to intervene with first and how early.
abandono-estudiantil.solution: Logistic regression vs. Random Forest, with the decision threshold as a business dial and a prioritized list.

caso-arquitectura.title: Case Study: Systems Analyst
caso-arquitectura.problem: Full systems-analysis cycle for an architecture firm: requirements gathering, modeling and methodology.
caso-arquitectura.solution: 14 navigable chapters with UML, ERD, DFD and 13 documented Scrum sprints.
